name: Decider V1.1 27B
description: Perplexity Decider V1.1 27B is Perplexity’s multimodal decision model for classification, routing, and scoring. It evaluates text, structured JSON, and images against yes/no questions, custom choices, and ordered rubrics, returning typed answers with probabilities. It supports multiple questions over shared content, making it useful for support triage, content moderation, visual inspection, and automated decision workflows
